name: No-op child
fixed_work: One synthetic process with specified exit/output
calibration_rule: Do not lengthen; exposes fixed overhead
behavior_check: Exit and exact output bytes

name: Empty Godot application
fixed_work: Load minimal project and complete a valid sentinel action
calibration_rule: No artificial useful-work expansion
behavior_check: Sentinel action count and clean exit

name: Straight-line arithmetic
fixed_work: Fixed operation batches at 1x/2x/4x sizes
calibration_rule: Pilot base size on B0; freeze all conditions
behavior_check: Analytically checked result/checksum

name: Branch-heavy deterministic logic
fixed_work: Fixed decision count over predefined input sequence
calibration_rule: Pilot 1–5 second B0 work; identical counts thereafter
behavior_check: Known arm counts and final state

name: Calls lambdas and recursion
fixed_work: Fixed calls and bounded depth
calibration_rule: Freeze base call count; depth is separate factor
behavior_check: Known call counts and return result

name: Signals and deferred dispatch
fixed_work: Fixed number of connections/emissions and explicit queue drains
calibration_rule: Pilot emission count; preserve delivery work
behavior_check: Expected deliveries and deterministic final state

name: Await state machines
fixed_work: Fixed resumptions from controlled signals/steps
calibration_rule: Scale work count rather than wall-clock delay
behavior_check: Known continuation counts and state

name: Allocation and object churn
fixed_work: Fixed object create/use/release batches
calibration_rule: Freeze count and lifetime pattern
behavior_check: Expected live-object transitions and results

name: Arrays dictionaries and resources
fixed_work: Fixed data size and operation schedule
calibration_rule: Predefine multiple input sizes after pilot
behavior_check: Expected contents and stable output

name: Script discovery and loading
fixed_work: Separate selected-file count loaded-file count and source size sweeps
calibration_rule: Proposed 10/100/1000 scripts subject to pilot budget and limits
behavior_check: Exact selected/loaded manifest and sentinel outputs

name: Threaded collection
fixed_work: Fixed total work with 1/2/4 workers where supported
calibration_rule: Keep total work constant for contention; scaling separate
behavior_check: Joined total and declared count semantics

name: Representative scene application
fixed_work: Recorded fixed-step scenario with state signals resources and await
calibration_rule: Pilot bounded scenario length; freeze steps and seeds
behavior_check: Known checkpoints and final state plus selected hit obligations

name: Public real-project scenario
fixed_work: Pinned project revision/assets and reproducible scenario
calibration_rule: Choose after reproducibility and license review
behavior_check: Project-specific observable checkpoints

name: Offline report processing
fixed_work: Immutable validated native reports at several record/byte sizes
calibration_rule: Freeze corpus and render options
behavior_check: Expected record totals and source identities

name: Fresh import and repeated launch
fixed_work: Same project with/without generated import state
calibration_rule: Separate project-cache states; OS cache uncontrolled unless established
behavior_check: Completed import and sentinel application output

name: Rendered frame workload
fixed_work: Fixed frame sequence with recorded renderer/display settings
calibration_rule: Pilot enough frames for selected quantiles; freeze count
behavior_check: Frame count and application checkpoints

name: Exported application
fixed_work: Supported debug/release template scenarios as distinct strata
calibration_rule: Match W11 scenario if feasible
behavior_check: Export identity and standalone expected behavior

name: Log-volume child
fixed_work: Fixed stdout/stderr byte counts and production patterns
calibration_rule: Sweep bounded volumes chosen in pilot
behavior_check: Exact emitted/received counts and exit

name: Waiting child
fixed_work: Known wait interval with negligible requested CPU work
calibration_rule: Freeze intervals; compare wall and CPU separately
behavior_check: Completion and recorded wait request

name: Memory-lifetime child
fixed_work: Known allocation/release sequence with explicit retention window
calibration_rule: Freeze sizes and durations within machine budget
behavior_check: Allocation lifecycle and bounded expected behavior
